intro: Night report: the bots ran the floor. Nobody was in charge. It went about as you'd expect.
While you slept the bots held a meeting. It was mostly about snacks.
The night shift clocked in {hours} hours. The Foreman supervised from a very comfy chair.
earn: The bots made {commendations} commendations. The Foreman took credit for {credit}.
{commendations} commendations earned overnight. Nobody asked how.
Overnight output: {commendations} commendations and one suspicious puddle.
bot: {bot} worked through the night and only broke things a little.
{bot} ran {bot_hours} hours of shifts. Mostly in circles.
{bot} learned something. We're all very nervous.
mess_0: The floor is spotless. This is deeply unsettling.
No mess. The Foreman has checked twice.
mess_1: There's a small mess waiting for you. One machine is sulking.
A little mess on the floor. It's probably fine.
mess_2: Two machines are not speaking to you this morning.
The night shift left a mess. Two messes, actually.
mess_3: The floor is a disaster. The bots call it 'a learning opportunity'.
Three machines are jammed. The bots blame each other and a ghost.
